|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles and 4 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Once per turn, may ▼ Probe Droid to a related site.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Stalker (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “May add 6 pilots, 8 passengers, 2 vehicles and 4 TIEs. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. During your deploy phase, may deploy one [Virtual] Probe Droid to a related site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' removed “Has ship-docking capability.”; “Once per turn,” → “During your deploy phase,”; “▼” → “deploy one [Virtual]”; “site.” → “site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=5 VirtualCards4.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown); page 5, slip 48. Slip image and game text from this sheet. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195348/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf Internet Archive primary-source copy].
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Stalker]].
* Later text: [[Stalker (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Stalker (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Stalker]].
